user_query: I'm organizing a family reunion and I want to create a family tree. Can you generate faces of family members with the parameters 'gender: female', 'age: 40s', and 'ethnicity: west_asian'? Additionally, generate an image of a tree using the 'Stable Diffusion v2' tool. Lastly, I need to predict the number of attendees based on previous attendance. Use the 'Timeseries Prediction Model' API with the values [50, 60, 70] and dates ['2023-07-01', '2023-07-02', '2023-07-03'].

TaskList.description: Generate faces of female family members aged in their 40s with West Asian ethnicity.
Generate an image of a tree using the Stable Diffusion v2 tool.
Predict the number of attendees for the family reunion based on previous attendance using the Timeseries Prediction Model.
